info.title: An Tam local pose test API
info.description: Loopback-only test interface. Calls the existing Python engine. No Firebase, FCM, frame persistence or cloud upload. One active browser session; starting another invalidates the previous session.

200.description: Local engine capabilities and model availability

post.description: Reset all temporal/identity evidence; create a fresh random session. Requires an allowed localhost Origin.
Send one JPEG frame at its source video time. Strictly increasing timestamps, at most one request in flight in the client. Seeking/restarting must create a new session.

frame.description: data:image/jpeg;base64,...; maximum JSON request 1.5 MB; decoded frame no larger than1280x1280

200.description: Existing Engine result plus normalized landmarks, image dimensions and inference_ms; confidence is pose visibility, not a probability of falling

400.description: Invalid image, body, timestamp or dimensions

409.description: Session expired; create a new one
